allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: Silgo Retail Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Rights issue first and final call  is 06-Apr-2026.

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Silgo Retail Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on February 13, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 7381359 : 24604529, i.e 7381359 Equity Shares for every 24604529 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 60 per share.

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Silgo Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'closure of offer period of rights issue'.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Silgo Retail Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates-ISIN for Rights Entitlements for Rights Issue

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Silgo Retail Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Closure of offer Period of Preferential issue'.
